item.title: Governor Announces Increased DPS Border Operations
item.description: (Austin, TX) — Governor Abbott has ordered increased operations along the southern border to enhance safety following the death of a cartel leader. The governor ordered the Department of Public Safety to ramp up safety and security operations yesterday to prevent any spillover activity following weekend violence in Mexico. item.title: Pharr Announces $3.5M Grant For International Bridge Improvements
item.description: (Pharr, TX) — The City of Pharr is getting a federal grant to help improve the Pharr International Bridge. The city announced yesterday that Congresswoman Monica De La Cruz helped secure a three-point-five-million-dollar grant for modernization and upgrades to the bridge. Improvements will include repaving the bridge entry area, new electronic signage and a new bridge gantry. The bridge headquarters building will also be expanded to provide more space for law enforcement and other operations.

item.title: Trump Expected To Visit Corpus Christi On Friday Of This Week
item.description: (Corpus Christi, TX) — President Donald Trump is reportedly coming to Texas a few days before next week’s primary elections. item.title: Instagram Says It Will Notify Parents If Teens ‘repeatedly’ Search For Terms Related To Suicide
item.description: By BARBARA ORTUTAY AP Technology Writer Instagram said Thursday it will start alerting parents if their kids repeatedly search for terms clearly associated with suicide or self-harm. The alerts will only go to parents who are enrolled in Instagram’s parental supervision program. Instagram says it already blocks such content from showing up in teen accounts’ search results and directs people to helplines instead. The announcement comes as Meta is in the midst of two trials over harms to children.

item.title: US Filings For Jobless Aid Rise Modestly To 212,000 As Layoffs Remain At Historically Healthy Levels
item.description: By MATT OTT AP Business Writer WASHINGTON (AP) — Slightly more Americans applied for unemployment benefits last week as layoffs remain at relatively healthy levels.
